definitions.gloss: allowance; remittance to family; financial support sent from a distance
definitions.explanation: Money sent regularly to support a family member living elsewhere, most commonly from parents to a child attending university in another city, or from a worker to their family back home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕送|しおく}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm living on the allowance from my parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕送|しおく}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十万|じゅうまん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧だ。

⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仕送|しおく}り⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|た}り→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ず、⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: After starting university, the allowance alone wasn't enough, so I started working part-time too.

notes:
{仕送|しおく}り refers to money sent regularly to support a family member living in a different location. The most typical scenario is parents sending money to a child studying at a university away from home.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕送|しおく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to send money/an allowance)
- {仕送|しおく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive an allowance)
- {仕送|しおく}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}する→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧ (to live on an allowance)
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕送|しおく}り (monthly allowance)

The word can also be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {仕送|しおく}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.
